newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy recovering, job situation tough -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy recovering, job situation tough -- MOF.

text.p: Japan's economy is continuing to recover and although the pace of the recovery is gradual, private demand is getting firmer, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Wednesday.
Mitsuzuka, who made the remarks in a prepared statement on a visit to the Osaka mint, also said Japan's employment situation was improving but remained severe.

"The economy continues to recover. Although the pace is gradual, private demand is becoming firmer," Mitsuzuka said, adding that the government would implement appropriate policies to ensure the recovery continued and was linked to medium- and long-term stable growth.
He also said that fiscal reform was vital.
